question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c2d981bc648ff3c1807e3d1d3c141cc784dc0df8655c44b32461486a869521.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

**Pattern ⇒** 3 box shifting in the clockwise direction → next two boxes no change → Shifting starts again

1) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f93be6ddf5b1699b8e447f0153b9b784ea6a9742f71fe0aa5d8faa4a4c6efb9.png] ' element →

 
• Shifting in the clockwise direction
 
• Started shifting from the 2nd box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90f736977f45331e03bec8e958919560de11434c1c0015b91192e4ef2080f010.png] 

2) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9f68ea25399fae703aa799bf5d2f4a9ad89004622c20d0faa10dc248caaac89.png] ' element → 

 
• Shifting in the clockwise direction
 
• After shifting in 2nd box, no change in the position in 3rd box
 
• After 3rd box started shifting from 4th box

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905378d231bd852f251d4d24dfb4062ffac9ba23c9e72701096d8ddeaa25f510.png] 

3) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/911e48063f218b2ca3f0b370b01ca46c29464f7991b162af1b4d6ef2d986423f.png] ' element → 

 
• Shifting in the clockwise direction.
 
• No change after 3rd box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1421d78ff2d28068acf022bb5209b38bd891f59f99960030446c04de576d29c.png] 

4) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1019acd74f62b7082157863b80b11496289f56e77e4e9985a177dfaac4a71b8e.png] ' element → 

 
• Shifting in the anticlockwise direction.
 
• After shifting in 3rd box, no change in 4th box. 
 
• Shifted after 4th box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaec18d7b7666076d91a79d75390b59d55572d1a40383bdb896bdb902f066237.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14f3caf92d23675f039771c6db22cdfb411c0aae985f3413e05b126d74c89d67.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
